scope: Reference dance / continuous movement imitation with pose-based temporal alignment and localized errors
verification_note: Primary sources only. Availability was checked at paper/repository/documentation level; models and code were not executed by this literature review. No paper reproduction or reported benchmark result is claimed.

papers.title: Soft-DTW: a Differentiable Loss Function for Time-Series
papers.task: Differentiable temporal alignment between time series
papers.release_status: Author paper links official implementation; no pretrained weights needed for the alignment algorithm.
papers.relevance: Motivates tempo-tolerant alignment. Our planned hard-DTW baseline is not a reproduction of soft-DTW training.
papers.limitations: Alignment cost alone does not establish correct choreography or preserve required hold durations.

papers.title: Temporal Cycle-Consistency Learning
papers.task: Self-supervised per-frame representation learning and video alignment
papers.release_status: Official TensorFlow training, embedding extraction, evaluation and alignment visualization code available; README gives ImageNet backbone initialization, not a verified ready-to-use dance compliance checkpoint.
papers.relevance: Frame correspondences and action phase evaluation; supports showing aligned evidence.
papers.limitations: Learned alignment is not an instruction-compliance classifier; target-domain validation is needed.

papers.title: Learning by Aligning Videos in Time
papers.task: Self-supervised video representation learning using soft-DTW and temporal regularization
papers.release_status: Official PyTorch code, environment, train/evaluate commands available; no trained dance checkpoint identified in the checked README.
papers.relevance: Explains why temporal alignment and temporal discrimination must be considered together.
papers.limitations: Paper is CVPR 2021, not 2022. Evaluates Pouring, Penn Action, IKEA ASM; does not directly certify dance imitation correctness.

papers.title: View-Invariant Probabilistic Embedding for Human Pose
papers.task: View-invariant probabilistic embeddings from 2D joint keypoints
papers.release_status: Official TensorFlow training and infer.py available. Author discussion confirms an original pretrained checkpoint existed; checkpoint download was not tested in this review.
papers.relevance: Alternative representation when camera viewpoint varies.
papers.limitations: Author notes checkpoint sensitivity to keypoint-detector domain and original checkpoint missing-keypoint limitations. Embedding similarity does not localize anatomical errors by itself.

papers.title: BlazePose: On-device Real-time Body Pose tracking
papers.release_status: Current official MediaPipe Tasks docs provide Python/Web guides and downloadable Lite/Full/Heavy pose-landmarker bundles.
papers.relevance: Practical single-person RGB pose frontend; confidence-gated normalized keypoints are inspectable.
papers.limitations: Current MediaPipe bundle is a BlazePose/GHUM variant, not an exact reproduction of the 2020 architecture. Monocular inferred world coordinates are not motion-capture ground truth.

papers.title: RTMPose: Real-Time Multi-Person Pose Estimation based on MMPose
papers.release_status: Official model zoo links PTH/ONNX weights and inference examples. Official README also recommends rtmlib for ONNXRuntime/OpenCV/OpenVINO without PyTorch/MMCV.
papers.relevance: Alternative pose frontend, including whole-body variants and explicit deployment choices.
papers.limitations: Top-down pipeline needs person localization; pose confidence/AP is not action-compliance accuracy. Author FPS cannot be substituted for our full-pipeline timing.

papers.title: AI Choreographer: Music Conditioned 3D Dance Generation with AIST++
papers.task: Dance dataset and music-conditioned 3D dance generation
papers.release_status: Official annotation downloads and API available; video downloader points to original AIST videos and their terms. SMPL-related assets have separate requirements.
papers.relevance: Real dance motion/camera data and cross-view tests; reference and candidate selection can be made explicit.
papers.limitations: 1,408 sequences and 10 genres describe dataset scope, not imitation-correctness labels. Official docs require exact 60-FPS frame extraction and recommend an ignore list for poor reconstructions.

papers.title: FineDance: A Fine-grained Choreography Dataset for 3D Full Body Dance Generation
papers.task: Full-body dance generation and music-motion data
papers.release_status: Official repo links a 7.7-hour public subset, pretrained generation checkpoints/assets and inference scripts.
papers.relevance: Dance-specific motions and dancer-disjoint evaluation design; useful future benchmark source.
papers.limitations: Paper describes 14.6 hours, while checked release states a 7.7-hour subset. Generation checkpoint is not a reference-imitation assessor; SMPLH data and assets need their own setup.

papers.title: Human Motion Instruction Tuning
papers.task: Video, native motion and text conditioned human-motion understanding
papers.release_status: Paper says code/models available, but checked official repository contained only README.md and no runnable implementation or checkpoint link.
papers.relevance: Relevant direction for natural-language motion questions and descriptions.
papers.limitations: Instruction tuning is not evidence of calibrated arbitrary instruction-compliance decisions; not selected for the runnable baseline.

papers.title: Learning Quantised Structure-Preserving Motion Representations for Dance Fingerprinting
papers.release_status: Paper claims a dataset release; no author code, dataset download or pretrained checkpoint URL was identified in the checked abstract/full text/search.
papers.relevance: Recent example distinguishing global dance retrieval from local correctness and temporal order.
papers.limitations: Retrieval accuracy is not imitation-quality accuracy. The paper explicitly lists loss of temporal ordering among limitations; no reproduction claimed.

papers.title: FineDiving: A Fine-grained Dataset for Procedure-aware Action Quality Assessment
papers.release_status: Official TSA training/evaluation code available; dataset requires a signed agreement and email request. README test checkpoint is produced by training.
papers.relevance: Supports explicit sub-action phases and reference/query comparisons.
papers.limitations: Diving scoring and known step-transition count assumptions do not transfer directly to open dance imitation.

papers.title: FineParser: A Fine-grained Spatio-temporal Action Parser for Human-centric Action Quality Assessment
papers.task: Human-centric spatiotemporal parsing for diving quality assessment
papers.release_status: Official PyTorch code and train/test configuration available. FineDiving-HM requires release agreement/email; README links I3D backbone weights, not a verified final fine-tuned FineParser checkpoint.
papers.relevance: Fine-grained spatial and temporal evidence is more useful than one opaque scalar.
papers.limitations: Diving-domain supervision and masks are required; no arbitrary choreography pass/fail transfer established.

papers.title: Hierarchical NeuroSymbolic Approach for Comprehensive and Explainable Action Quality Assessment
papers.task: Neural symbols plus rules for explainable platform-diving assessment
papers.release_status: Official Python single-video entrypoint and HTML report code, plus hosted demo link. Dependency/weight completeness not executed or verified; repo restricts materials to non-commercial use.
papers.relevance: Conceptual support for explainable evidence plus an explicit decision specification.
papers.limitations: The rules are sport-specific. This experiment borrows the separation-of-evidence-and-rules idea, not its code or trained pipeline.

papers.title: Domain Knowledge-Informed Self-Supervised Representations for Workout Form Assessment
papers.task: Workout form assessment for back squat, overhead press and barbell row
papers.release_status: Code_Release directory available; dataset is request-based and non-commercial. Turnkey pretrained inference not verified.
papers.relevance: Demonstrates that recognizing an exercise and detecting execution errors are separate objectives.
papers.limitations: Exercise-specific expert error labels do not provide dance-sequence correctness labels.

papers.title: FLEX: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Multi-Action Dataset for Fitness Action Quality Assessment
papers.task: Multimodal fitness action quality dataset with structured error feedback
papers.release_status: Paper advertises code/data; linked project returned HTTP 404 during this review, so immediate download/weights could not be verified.
papers.relevance: Structured errors and feedback offer a better target than a generic action label.
papers.limitations: Weight-loaded fitness, 3D pose and sEMG setting differs from monocular dance imitation. An ICLR 2026 submission PDF was seen, but acceptance was not verified.

papers.title: Revisiting Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
papers.task: Action recognition from spatiotemporal pose heatmaps
papers.release_status: Official repository and PoseC3D configs/training/testing instructions available; not installed in this review.
papers.relevance: Useful recognition baseline and pose representation alternative.
papers.limitations: Correct action class does not establish correct side, amplitude, phrase order or completion.
